text: The keyboard is not bad and well designed, and like any other keyboard, there's going to be a missed word here and there. However, the only drawback for me is the pricing. To me, it's a little bit outrageously priced. (That price tag is steep for a phone keyboard, especially when $30 a month or $150 a year ends up costing more than most major streaming subscriptions.) If it wasn't for that, it would definitely be a 5-star rating
replyText: Hi, thanks so much for the kind words about the keyboard and design! We hear you on the pricing and have shared it with our team. Good news: every user gets a free 1-month membership, so you can enjoy all the Pro features before deciding. Hope we can earn that 5th star!
